Fluid.Title: 2D Smoke / Ink Flow
Fluid.Summary: Fixed grid-based GPU solver. Resources are declared first, then ordered compute passes with explicit reads and writes. These arrows are dependencies, not Signal wires or a live trace.
Fluid.ResourceOwnership: The effect owns these fields and the sampled output texture. Scratch fields are reused between passes. This is not access to the engine's main framebuffer. Extra user-defined passes are not supported yet.
Fluid.Validated: 2D fluid settings, resource plan and source exports validated. This is not an engine execution result.
Fluid.Units: Closed XY domain. Width/height are grid cells (8-1024); source X/Y are normalized (0-1). Domain size and radius use local units; source velocity is acceleration per second. Density is injected per second. Excess long-frame time is discarded after the substep budget. Draw uses an explicit built-in premultiplied-alpha material.
